methods.description: Multiply every inside term by the outside term, applying integer signs and algebraic multiplication; a bare minus means −1. Numeric/algebraic multipliers and two/three terms are variations of this rule.
Distribute a subtraction or negative term across a bracket, then combine resulting like terms while preserving constants.
